programs.title: Finding Curios Season II Ep.2

programs.title: From Farm to Table (China-France Season) Ep.1
programs.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 60th anniversary of Sino-French diplomatic relations, this program focuses on the full-chain coordination mechanism that brings food from French farms to Chinese tables, capturing the collision and fusion of two great food cultures.
